statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
Mobile cardiac telemetry is clinically indicated to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias
Mobile cardiac telemetry is clinically indicated to assess the efficacy of current rate control management
The service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
